targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM((payload->'usage'->>'cost_usd')::float8),0) AS total_usd FROM events WHERE type='stage_completed' AND payload ? 'usage'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((payload->>'total_cost_usd')::float8),0) AS avg_usd FROM events WHERE type='run_completed'

SELECT r.ticket_title || ' · ' || right(r.run_id, 6) AS run, (e.payload->>'total_cost_usd')::float8 AS cost_usd, (e.payload->>'total_turns')::int AS turns FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = e.run_id WHERE e.type='run_completed' ORDER BY r.created_at

panels.title: Cost by stage (all runs, stacked by model)

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'stage_id' AS stage, SUM((payload->'usage'->>'cost_usd')::float8) AS cost_usd FROM events WHERE type='stage_completed' AND payload ? 'usage' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT r.ticket_title AS run, e.payload->>'stage_id' AS stage, (e.payload->>'turns_used')::int AS turns, round(((e.payload->'usage'->>'cost_usd')::numeric), 4) AS cost_usd, round(((e.payload->>'duration_ms')::numeric)/1000) AS seconds FROM events e JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=e.run_id WHERE e.type='stage_completed' ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 50
